No file changes detected; documentation content remains functionally the same.  
- No updates to code or documentation were made in this version.
- All instructions, guidance, and examples are unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of Automation Workflow Plus, your assistant for turning repetitive weekly tasks into automated workflows.

- Guides users to identify high-value automation opportunities and calculate ROI.
- Recommends suitable tools: workflow platforms (Dify, Coze, n8n) or RPA scripts requiring zero token cost.
- Provides clear tool comparisons and selection guidelines for both workflow automation and RPA.
- Includes step-by-step instructions on designing, building, testing, and maintaining automations.
- Offers classic scenario templates for common business automation needs, with detailed operation guides for each.
- Skill triggers on keywords related to automation, repetitive tasks, workflows, efficiency, RPA, and related concepts.
